recordSet.description: Station metadata from Colombia's Instituto de Hidrología, Meteorología y Estudios Ambientales (IDEAM), distributed through the IDEAM Open Data Cloud Object Store (https://datos.ideam.gov.co/s3-estacionesideam/) and Datos Abiertos Colombia (https://www.datos.gov.co/). This RivRetrieve projection is distributed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). RivRetrieve selected the declared source fields and encoded their values and absence states; source names and elevations remain unchanged. Processing and publication of this projection: RivRetrieve.
